speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for coming in. I see you have fatigue, difficulty concentrating, and abnormal blood findings; to narrow this down, could you describe the specific abnormalities you were told you have?

speaker: Patient
text: 53-year-old male. The patient has a 3-week history of fatigue, difficulty to concentrate, and dyspnea on exertion. He also experiences dizziness and digital pain that improves with cold. He has a long history of smoking.

speaker: Doctor
text: That digital pain improving with cold suggests acrocyanosis; have you noticed any pale, waxy-looking skin or brittle nails? Additionally, has anyone in your family ever been diagnosed with a blood disorder?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue and difficulty to concentrate. I also have Dyspnea on exertion, Dizziness, Digital pain that improves with cold.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pernicious Anemia (likely secondary to gastric issues given fatigue, neuro symptoms, and smoking history). REQUEST IMAGES: None needed at this time; proceed with B12 levels and intrinsic antibody testing.
